info: Migration 0014: taxa_zero_e_tipo_ato. Legacy tipo_ato must be normalized before CHECK constraint. Zero payments cleaned and constraint enforced.
Pendencias module: production checkpoint implemented. Reopen and conference actions clarified. Filter by escrevente fixed. Refresh after ato save.
Import flow: spreadsheet preview, cancellation with rollback delete, reset-empty bootstrap utility. Preview shows detailed errors and warnings.
Payment model: launched vs confirmed payments are separate. Finance conference mode dedicated. Financial confirmation save flow separated from regular ato save.
Reusable filter sheets pattern: extracted and applied across dashboard, reports, and livros. Responsive sheet pattern is canonical UI pattern.
Tax history (P2): in progress in homolog. deploy incident: legacy tipo_ato constraint failure documented in docs/22-deploy-incidents-2026-03-23.md.
Currency calculations apply Math.round to commission and reembolso outputs to prevent IEEE 754 floating-point drift. Escrevente lookup batched to eliminate N+1.
Silent catch blocks in reembolsos, reivindicacoes, usuarios routes now log errors. PainelUsuarios surfaces API load failure instead of empty table.
Escrevente tax history: table escreventes_taxas_historico (migrations 0011/0012). Logic in backend/lib/taxas-historico.js. Backfill baseline migration included.
Pendencias module: migration 0013, backend/lib/pendencias.js, backend/routes/pendencias.js, sync-pendencias.js. Full frontend in Relatorios.jsx. E2E tests included.
Migration 0014 adds taxa CHECK constraint (0,6,20,30%). Certidão/testamento exempt from commission. buildAtosScope centralized in backend/lib/list-scopes.js.
Migration 0014 normalizes legacy free-text tipo_ato (ESCRTURA, DELARATÓRIA, etc.) to canonical lowercase before CHECK constraint. Unrecognized values become NULL.
Pagination via usePagination hook + Pagination UI component. Page size persisted in localStorage. Applied to Atos and all 5 Relatorios tabs.
Currency rounding: Math.round applied to commission and reembolso outputs to prevent IEEE 754 drift. deleteImportedEscreventesIfOrphan uses batch SELECT to avoid N+1.
Silent catch blocks in reembolsos, reivindicacoes, usuarios routes were swallowing errors. Added console.error. PainelUsuarios now surfaces API load failures.
Textual ato search centralized in frontend/src/utils/search.js. Covers livros and all Relatorios tabs.
Pendencias list auto-refreshes after ato save (App.jsx). Filter by escrevente was broken in both backend route and Relatorios.jsx — fixed in commit 34ac8df.
Henrique P3 scope: despesas-registro module (migrations 0016-0018), ato-permissions lib, user-preferences (column visibility), auxiliar-registro routes and tests added.
Permission isolation applied: declaro/compartilhamento routes removed, manifestar redesigned. Impacts access control boundaries.

Commission leak fix (Mar-25): escrevente now sees only own commissions via permission isolation. Migration 0019 adds tipo_manifestacao, livro_ref, pagina_ref to pendencias. Manifestar redesigned with situation types (reivindicar, excluir, retificar, esclarecer, outros).

P3 schema: migrations 0016 (usuarios_preferencias), 0017 (despesas_registro), 0018 (auxiliar_registro). New routes: despesas-registro, ato-permissions, user-preferences. buildAtosScope centralized in list-scopes.js.

Taxa constraint: CHECK(0,6,20,30) on atos via migration 0014. Tipo_ato constraint with legacy normalization before CHECK. Compartilhamento restricted to captador scope only. Pagination with localStorage-persisted page size.

Currency precision: Math.round applied to commission and reembolso outputs to prevent IEEE 754 floating-point drift. Escrevente lookup batched to eliminate N+1 query in deleteImportedEscreventesIfOrphan.
